title: docs(upgrading): the Per-release specifics table has no v18.2.0 row — 18.2.0 is published and its upgrade checklist (releases/v18/18-2) is not linked from the upgrade guide
body:
Filing gate: ① product docs defect, shipped text (content/docs/upgrading.mdx), named location.

- Business reason: an operator moving a deployment to the published 18.2.0 opens the upgrade guide, which says the per-release specifics live in that release's checklist. The table stops at v18.1.0, so the reader never learns that 18.2.0 has an upgrade checklist. That checklist is content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx, which landed after the release in #26494. #24904 and #24905 closed the same gap for 18.0.0.
- Who acts: the docs lane owning content/docs/upgrading.mdx. The fix is one table row, "| v18.2.0 | [Upgrade checklist — 18.2.0](/docs/releases/v18/18-2#upgrade-checklist) |", above the v18.1.0 row, with the anchor checked against 18-2.mdx.
- Dedupe (open and closed): "upgrading.mdx 18.2.0 row per-release specifics release notes 18-2 page" gave 10 hits, and "Upgrading per-release specifics table missing v18.2.0 row" gave 8. #26429 (closed) wrote 18-2.mdx but not the upgrading row. #24904 and #24905 (closed) are the 18.0.0 instances.

QA-source: #26629 · smoke:npm-18.2.0 · C3
type: Bug

## Reproduction

1. git show 27f38ada:content/docs/upgrading.mdx and read "Per-release specifics". Do the same on main (measured at 7c34e5dc).
2. Expected: a v18.2.0 row linking the 18.2.0 upgrade checklist. Actual: the newest row is v18.1.0 in both.
3. At the release commit, content/docs/releases/v18/ holds 18-0.mdx, 18-1.mdx and index.mdx only. 18-2.mdx exists on main from #26494.

Full evidence chain: the run record #26629, cell C3.
